name: Krath war droid
description: The Krath war droid was an ancient type of droid. When creating the ED-V8-series envoy droid, the Rseikharhl Droid Group built it around the chassis of a Krath war droid. It shared its name with the Krath, an ancient group from the Deep Core. The IG-series 100 MagnaGuard that was produced by Holowan Laboratories for the Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies, General Grievous, took inspiration from the Krath war droid.
